CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Conquest and settlement in Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Conquest and settlement in Canaan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Conquest and settlement in Canaan has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conquest and settlement in Canaan.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Judges has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Judges.

   D. Use Selected Judges to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Approaches to Leisure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Approaches to Work and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
